card.description: Customer Choice Index is a comprehensive diagnosis of customer experience that reveals the real reasons for victories and defeats in the fight for the customer. The research goes far beyond traditional quality assessments and focuses on critical decision-making moments.

cci.title: What is Customer Choice Index?
cci.subtitle:
This is a comprehensive study using the 'Mystery Shopper' method, which analyzes the entire customer journey
— from the first internet search to service operations in the branch. We don't just
give scores, we measure key indices that directly influence the customer's decision.

item1.title: Complete customer journey
item1.description: Our mystery shoppers go through scenarios for both new and existing customers, evaluating acquisition and service processes.

item2.title: Two detailed scorecards
item2.description: We separately evaluate the Online journey (website, app, chats) and Offline journey (call, branch visit).

item3.title: Additional indices
item3.description: Based on the criteria built into the scorecards, we calculate 4 additional indices that provide a complete understanding of the customer experience.

why_leaving.title: Why do customers leave without starting to work with you?
why_leaving.subtitle:
You invest millions in marketing and digital channels, but conversion doesn't grow. The problem
is hidden in customer journey gaps that you cannot see from the inside.

barrier1.title: Invisible barriers
barrier1.description: The customer encounters difficulties on the website, in the call center or branch, and you do not even know about it.

barrier2.title: Gap between Online and Offline
barrier2.description: Perfect digital experience collapses due to an incompetent employee in the branch. And vice versa.

barrier3.title: Misunderstanding competitors
barrier3.description: You don't know why customers actually choose other banks and what their real advantage is.
